name: Materials Science and Engineering
description: Materials engineering programmes teach why materials behave as they do and how to choose or design them — metals, polymers, ceramics, composites and semiconductors — which makes it the discipline sitting underneath every other engineering field’s failures.
degreesNote: ⚠ In Florida this is largely a GRADUATE programme: four public institutions award in it, but only the University of Florida and UCF award a bachelor’s, while FIU and USF are master’s and doctoral only. ⚠ That shapes the realistic route — many people enter materials through a mechanical, chemical or physics bachelor’s and specialise at master’s level. If materials is the goal and you cannot relocate, read those degrees first rather than treating this as a closed door.

cips.note: Materials Engineering — four Florida public institutions, and ⚠ only two of them at bachelor’s level, which is the most important fact on this page.

related.note: The commonest way into materials work in Florida: offered at eleven institutions, it covers mechanics of materials and manufacturing and is accepted for materials master’s admission. ⚠ Where there is no materials bachelor’s near you, this is the practical answer.
The other standard entry, and the better one if polymers, coatings, electrochemistry or semiconductor processing are what draw you.
The largest single consumer of materials expertise in Florida — composites, high-temperature alloys and fatigue. The two fields hire each other’s graduates constantly.
